verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents toggling flags independently per environment, unlimited environments, environment management through the Admin API and CLI, and an Environment Key that scopes SDK authentication to an environment. RBAC can also restrict who modifies production environments. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the per-environment key model (e.g. server-side secret keys versus the public client key), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
Authentication: Uses a public, non-secret Environment Key.
Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
